Rule 34's shape: in the idiom 'dia pantos tou zen' the ASV writes 'all their lifetime' and realizes the preposition nowhere, 'through' at t007 answering to the dative 'phobo'.

Rule 61's closing clause: the article of the articular infinitive is aligned where the ASV writes a determiner of its own, here the possessive 'their', which no other source token can take (rules 20, 76).

review_notes: 'through' at t007 is assigned to the dative 'phobo' rather than to 'dia', which the ASV's 'all their lifetime' leaves unrealized; the alternative of crossing 'through' onto 'dia' would leave the dative without its case preposition.
'their' is taken as the article's own determiner under rule 61's closing clause; reading it as unlicensed and marking it 'added' is the competing analysis.
